title: java-skeleton: pirca generator (only type, product and name)
scope: Turn java-skeleton into the pirca generator that asks only type (edge, flow, data, acl, lib), product and name, in two modes (interactive or --yes with flags). Remove all other flags, questions, the success message, port configuration and the java-app template; derive folder, artifact, group, package and serviceName; services get Application.java, libs get Example classes, everything starts at version 1.0.0 and libs always include publishing. Update README, CONTRIBUTING, manifest, package.json description and add a DEVLOG entry.
